scope: Standalone runtime builder, native packaging and installed validation scripts, Tauri configs, installer workflow and bundled-runtime launcher

reviewer.permissions: Read, Grep and Glob only; no commands or edits

reviewed_findings.finding: The native validator requires an empty workspace, while the package verifier seeded a preservation marker before launch and reused a workspace between Linux package checks.
reviewed_findings.assessment: Confirmed from both call sites and the validator guard; independently identified during integration before the review returned.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Fixed: each package uses a fresh workspace; the preservation marker is written after native validation and checked after uninstall. Exact release acceptance is recorded separately.

reviewed_findings.finding: Windows argument-list serialization quotes NSIS /D= and _?= tails containing spaces.
reviewed_findings.assessment: Confirmed against the NSIS command-line specification, which requires these final tails to be unquoted.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Fixed: explicit shell=False Windows command line with the NSIS-specific final unquoted path syntax. Verified by native per-user install and uninstall into a path containing spaces.

reviewed_findings.finding: The reviewer claimed platform-specific Tauri config files are not applied automatically.
reviewed_findings.assessment: False positive. The installed Tauri CLI help and official configuration reference explicitly confirm automatic platform-config merging.
reviewed_findings.disposition: No change required; retain normal automatic platform merge and the explicit release-runtime overlay.

configuration_validation: Workflow YAML parsed: workflow_dispatch only, main-only job guard, read-only repository permission, five native target rows.
macOS, Windows and Linux configs merged with base and bundle overlay validate against the installed Tauri CLI JSON schema.
Merged resource map preserves service.py and the complete runtime/ tree.
Referenced local installation/developer/release documentation links resolve; code fences are balanced.
Packaging script CLI contracts checked with --help; git diff --check passed.
limits: This is source/configuration review evidence, not installer acceptance.
Publish package validation reports from the exact installed artifacts separately.
No Developer ID, notarization, Authenticode, Linux distribution coverage or accelerator compatibility is established by this review.
